entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elf aether-seer and visionary inventor from Ghirapur, renowned for her study of the Great Conduit.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City on Avishkar where Rashmi lives.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: The source of aether that Rashmi studies.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The turbulent space between planes that Rashmi's visions reach.

entities.name: Greenwheel
entities.description: One of Ghirapur's greenest zones, Rashmi's home.

entities.name: Inquirium
entities.description: Rashmi's mobile research facility, a beetle-like walker on six legs.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Abducted Rashmi to expand her portal into the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Device expanded from Rashmi's miniature planar portal.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: Conflict during which Rashmi sabotaged her invention.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Rescued Rashmi along with the Renegades.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: Skyship completed by the Renegades and renamed by Rashmi.

entities.name: Hope of Ghirapur
entities.description: Thopter designed by Rashmi to disrupt Tezzeret's Aether Spire.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Rashmi defended her home.

events.summary: Rashmi creates a miniature planar portal that wins the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: Rashmi created a miniature planar portal

events.summary: Tezzeret abducts Rashmi and forces her to expand the design into the Planar Bridge.
During the Aether Revolt Rashmi sabotages her invention and is rescued by Saheeli and the Renegades.
Rashmi and Mitul join the Renegades and complete a skyship Rashmi renames the Heart of Kiran.
Rashmi defends her home during the New Phyrexian Invasion alongside Ragavan.
events.quote: Rashmi stood in defense of her home

relations.quote: She joined the Renegades alongside Mitul
fighting alongside allies such as Ragavan
